title: Emalahleni Local Municipality External Bursary 2027
sector: Local government — engineering, IT, finance, law, environmental management, architecture and other priority fields
qualification_level: Full-time undergraduate study at a public university or TVET college
source_name: Emalahleni Local Municipality — External Bursary Scheme advert
description: Emalahleni Local Municipality invites applications for its external bursary scheme for full-time undergraduate study at a public university or TVET college. Applicants must live in the Emalahleni municipal area, be aged 18 to 35, and show financial need. Applications are handed in at the municipality's Youth Development Unit, Civic Centre, Mandela Street, eMalahleni, and close on Friday 27 November 2026. Confirm every detail on the municipal notice before applying.
eligibility: Resident of Emalahleni Local Municipality (proof of residence required)
Aged 18 to 35 on the day of application
Planning to study full-time at a public university or TVET college in South Africa
documents_needed: Academic records (Grade 11, Grade 12 or tertiary, depending on status)
Provisional acceptance letter from a public university or TVET college
